findings.title: Architecture spec binds the 5.0.2 candidate to the 0.26.2 base
findings.trigger: A fresh Agent uses the Architecture Scope revision to recover or audit the current 5.0.2 reconciliation.
findings.impact: The named base resolves to the 0.26.2 release commit instead of the clean pre-Change recovery HEAD, leaving two conflicting provenance anchors and a bounded risk of auditing or recovering from the wrong baseline.
findings.evidence: git show identifies fc055021bcfeee3e8c6781b9545d267f5eb73cbd as chore(release): prepare 0.26.2, while the active intent Recovery field and research-distillate Scope both identify adb7bfe89f40e107d0c9c490076a6e74294b9337 as the 5.0.2 pre-Change recovery HEAD.
findings.suggestion: Replace the Revision value with adb7bfe89f40e107d0c9c490076a6e74294b9337, or explicitly label fc055021bcfeee3e8c6781b9545d267f5eb73cbd as historical and separately name the current recovery HEAD.

findings.title: Versioned documentation links point at mutable main
findings.trigger: After the repository main branch advances or one of the linked historical files moves, a consumer of the published 5.0.2 README follows the Documentation links.
findings.impact: The link can show later content or return 404, so the package cannot reliably reproduce the 5.0.2 contract, current North Star snapshot, or records described on the next line as frozen and hash-bound.
findings.evidence: Four newly externalized links use github.com/rocky2431/ultra-builder-pro-cli/blob/main, including the two links labeled frozen design history; README.zh-CN.md mirrors the same moving URLs, and the dry-run package omits these target files.
findings.suggestion: Use immutable commit- or release-tag-pinned GitHub URLs for versioned and frozen records, or include those files in the package; keep the English and Chinese mirrors identical.
